scope: Descriptive RBF biased MMD squared and feature Wasserstein distance on development normals only. No final features or labels opened. No training or selection uses these values.
method: Initial normal signed-log StandardScaler clipped20; equal fixed samples <=128; pooled positive median distance bandwidth; 199 label permutations
limits: File rows may be correlated. Nominal permutation p assumes exchangeability and is not a proven time-drift claim; 57 comparisons are exploratory, not corrected confirmatory tests. MMD values are kernel/sample/scaler dependent and not universal cross-dataset units.
